reasons.label: Match result
reasons.text: Como 1907 are favoured at 55%, against 24% for Racing Club de Lens and 21% for the draw. Como 1907 carry 78 more Elo points into the match. Over the last five: Racing Club de Lens 1.2 points per game, Como 1907 2.0.

reasons.label: Goals
reasons.text: The model expects 3.77 goals, which puts it over 2.5 at 73%. Across their last five, Racing Club de Lens and Como 1907 have scored 2.2 and conceded 2.2 a game between them. Como 1907 are the sharper of the two in front of goal right now, not Racing Club de Lens.

reasons.label: Self-correction
reasons.text: Adjusted from this competition's own record: goals were predicted 3.11 against 3.63 actual across 182 settled forecasts, so the rate is nudged up 16.9% to stop the model leaning under.
